business_summary: Konishi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells synthetic adhesives in Japan. It operates through three segments: Bonds, Chemical Products, and Construction Business. The company offers general household adhesives, repair material, and tape for consumer sector; interior construction adhesive, general residential sealant, and construction tape for housing-related fields; industrial adhesives, industrial tape, and industrial release agent, as well as various resin products for industrial materials; building construction repair sealant; and adhesives and repair materials for civil engineering construction. It also trades in chemical products for automotive, electronics and electrical, chemicals, paint, and housing related fields. In addition, the company engages in the provision of investigation, design, cost estimation, and construction of repair, reinforcement, and renovation work for concrete structures; contracting civil engineering and construction projects using construction adhesives; construction work for bridges and expressways. Further, it is involved in planning, design, construction and supervision of civil engineering and building works; and design and construction of architectural and civil engineering works. Konishi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
